How does the model behave? Behaviour explorer for the PlantVillage ResNet-18

Black-box view: only inputs and predictions. 1. Pick a condition on the left (cell colour = accuracy). 2. The matrix shows true class (rows) vs predicted class (columns) for that condition; the diagonal (correct) is hidden, so every coloured cell is a confusion. Hover for counts, click a cell to see the images. 3. The bars under the matrix show where wrong predictions go (sink classes); click a bar. Thumbnails show the unmodified image; the strip above them previews the selected change on one example leaf. Perturbation results use a stratified subset of 40 test images per class (32 for Potato healthy).
cell colour: accuracy (dark = low). number: accuracy in %.
Click a matrix cell or a bar.
